goal_observations_trials_chk.name: goal_observations_trials_chk
goal_observations_trials_chk.value: ("goal_observations"."trials_total" is null and "goal_observations"."trials_successful" is null) or ("goal_observations"."trials_total" > 0 and "goal_observations"."trials_successful" between 0 and "goal_observations"."trials_total")

goal_observations_independent_chk.name: goal_observations_independent_chk
goal_observations_independent_chk.value: "goal_observations"."independent_trials" is null or ("goal_observations"."trials_successful" is not null and "goal_observations"."independent_trials" between 0 and "goal_observations"."trials_successful")

parent_messages_sender_chk.name: parent_messages_sender_chk
parent_messages_sender_chk.value: ("parent_messages"."direction" = 'to_guardian' and "parent_messages"."sender_staff_id" is not null) or ("parent_messages"."direction" = 'from_guardian' and "parent_messages"."sender_guardian_id" is not null)
